t: Magnusson 120G wood sanding roll is a durable hand-sanding abrasive designed for flattening and smoothing timber surfaces. Ideal for carpenters and decorators for use on plaster, painted wood, interior wooden trims, skirting boards, or furniture. Constructed with strong E-weight paper backing and aluminium oxide, the fine-grit abrasive resists tearing while providing a consistent finish on hardwood and softwood. Features an open-coat design which reduces clogging for a cleaner finish and professional results. The dry-use roll measures 5m in length, allowing tradespeople to cut custom sheets to fit hand-sanding blocks.
b: Tough Paper Backing Resists Wear & Tearing
Fits Hand Blocks with Standard 115mm Width
Reduces Clogging & Dust Accumulation with Open Coat Design
Prepares Wood Surfaces for Smooth Paint & Varnish Application
Provides Efficient Cutting Action for Trade Carpentry Tasks
Optimises Dry Sanding Performance on Hardwood & Softwood
